root_cause: A canonical existing-candidate early exit treated an English patch file as proof of complete translations. A content-quality revision added new Dutch phrases, leaving protected CI incomplete.
fix: Reuse the canonical same-day writer and approved translation provider. Append only newly missing translations after exact production transforms. Retain fail-closed offline validation, existing PR identity, and source-content review.
prevention: Patch existence is not cache completeness
Require post-transform offline validation and exact-head Required/CodeQL
Never add a second scheduler, blog candidate, or synthetic live evidence
